needs.description: Complete puppy-formula dry kibble formulated for large/active puppies with controlled calories to support healthy growth and help manage elevated body weight; look for high-quality protein (not duck), glucosamine for developing joints, DHA for brain development, and a guaranteed analysis appropriate for puppies. Available in 4–30 lb bags with clear feeding guidelines and portion-control packaging. Prefer formulations from owner brand bias (Mars-compatible) if possible.
needs.rationale: AJ is a 7-month-old puppy (growth stage) who is very energetic but currently 40 lb (above typical pug weight). He needs puppy-specific balanced nutrition to support growth while managing calories to avoid excess weight. Dry kibble is essential for a consistent feeding routine and dental abrasion benefit.

needs.description: Moist canned puppy food or packaged wet toppers/gravy that are nutritious and duck-free to increase dietary moisture, improve palatability, and assist with hydration. Small cans/packets for portion control and mixing with dry kibble; choose formulas without added ingredients AJ is allergic to.
needs.rationale: Brachycephalic breeds like pugs and puppies benefit from additional moisture to help thermoregulation and palatability. During an excessive heat warning, added wet food helps maintain hydration and appetite. Also provides variety per standard-of-care guidance to include at least two food families.
evidence: standard: include multiple food types for hydration and variety

needs.description: Small, low-calorie training treats (soft and easily breakable) sized for repeated reward-based training and impulse control. Must be duck-free; include options with single-protein lamb, beef, or salmon. Pack sizes suitable for frequent reinforcement during short training sessions.
needs.rationale: AJ is a 7-month-old high-activity puppy undergoing socialization and training. Frequent small rewards are essential to shape behavior without excess calories. Training treats help with leash, recall, and apartment manners as family routine adjusts with school year.
evidence: standard: training uses many small, low-calorie treats

needs.description: Durable slow-feeding bowls and puzzle feeders sized for medium/large mouths that reduce gulping and extend meal time; dishwasher-safe, heavy base or suction to prevent tipping. Durable materials (BPA-free hard plastic or silicone) rated for strong chewers/enthusiastic eaters.
needs.rationale: Given AJ's high activity and elevated weight, slowing meal pace reduces bloat risk, helps portion control, and increases mental stimulation. Puzzle feeders also provide indoor enrichment on hot or rainy days.
evidence: standard: slow feeding for rapid eaters/weight management

needs.description: Extra-durable rubber or polyurethane chew toys designed for strong chewers: thick chew rings, heavy-duty rubber KONG-style toys (puppy-to-adult transition), and ballistic nylon chews. Avoid soft or poultry-based treat-in-chew products (duck). Select different sizes/widths for a pug's short muzzle and to withstand strong bite force.
needs.rationale: AJ is described as very energetic and very strong with strong chew strength and is teething as a puppy. He needs tough, safe chews that withstand hard chewing to prevent ingestion of broken pieces and to redirect destructive chewing.
evidence: about: AJ is very energetic and very strong
standard: provide durable, non-ingestible chews for strong chewers

needs.description: Non-destructible treat-dispensing puzzles and foraging toys to encourage problem-solving; made of durable plastic or fabric rated for moderate chewing (hide-and-seek treat puzzles, snuffle mats). Include washability and multiple difficulty levels for progressive enrichment.
needs.rationale: Apartment living and upcoming rainy season/rain season start require indoor enrichment to burn energy and reduce boredom. Interactive puzzles provide mental stimulation and reduce destructive behaviors in an active puppy.
evidence: calendar: Pacific Northwest Rain Season Start (2025-10-08 to 2025-11-14)

needs.description: Durable balls and launchable toys sized for a pug’s mouth but built to withstand strong power (rugged rubber balls, non-abrasive Chuck-It style compatible). Include indoor-safe soft options and outdoor durable options for large-yard play.
needs.rationale: AJ has high activity and access to a large yard. Fetch toys support high-energy exercise needs and recall training. Provide both indoor and outdoor varieties to suit apartment context and yard play.

needs.description: Strong, reinforced tug toys made from ballistic fabric, thick braided polyester or rubber with secure handles; sized appropriately to avoid neck strain on a brachycephalic neck. Washable and designed to resist shredding.
needs.rationale: Tug play is a high-energy interactive game that supports bonding and impulse control training; because AJ is powerful, select heavy-duty materials to avoid ingestion hazards.
evidence: standard: provide durable, safe tug toys for strong chewers

needs.description: Dog toothbrush (finger brush + dual-head), enzymatic toothpaste flavored to dog preferences (non-chicken flavors available), and VOHC-accepted dental chews (ensure duck-free). Dental chew sizes appropriate for AJ’s jaw size and chew strength; consider daily wipes as an alternative.
needs.rationale: Dental care is standard-of-care for all dogs to prevent periodontal disease. Puppies benefit from early toothbrushing habituation. AJ’s strong chewing can accelerate tartar if not managed.
evidence: standard: dental care for all pets

needs.description: Products to prevent overheating: cooling mats (gel or evaporative), evaporative cooling vest sized for a pug’s chest, portable misting fan, and shaded canopy for yard use. Breathable raised/elevated bed (mesh) to increase airflow underneath. All cooling items should be easy to clean and stable for a robust dog.
needs.rationale: An excessive heat warning is active and pugs are brachycephalic and heat-sensitive. Immediate cooling gear is essential to prevent heat stress. Elevated beds and shaded yard solutions help regulate body temperature during warm periods.

needs.description: Large-capacity stainless steel or ceramic elevated water bowls, travel water bottle with integrated bowl for walks, and a pet water fountain for constant fresh water in the apartment. Consider insulated bottles for warm days and a sturdy base to prevent tipping from a strong dog.
needs.rationale: Excessive heat warning and high activity increase water needs. Continuous access to cool, fresh water is essential for thermoregulation and overall health, especially for a brachycephalic puppy.

needs.description: Padded, wide, front-clip or dual-clip harness designed for short-nosed breeds to minimize neck pressure; adjustable straps for growing puppies and heavy-duty buckles for strong pullers. Fit-tested to avoid tracheal compression.
needs.rationale: Pugs have sensitive tracheas and collars can cause injury—use a harness to distribute force. AJ is a powerful, strong chewer/puller; a secure harness helps control him safely on walks in urban or hunting-season areas.
evidence: about: AJ is very energetic and very strong
standard: brachycephalic dogs should avoid neck pressure

needs.description: Heavy-duty 4–6 ft leash with reinforced stitching, optional traffic handle, plus reflective vest or LED-lit collar attachments for visibility. Include reflective harness covers and a high-visibility walking vest when in areas with hunters or during low-light walks.
needs.rationale: Calendar indicates hunting season and ongoing leaf-blower/noise events; reflective visibility improves safety outdoors; a sturdy leash is necessary for a strong 40-lb puppy.

needs.description: Appropriately sized crate (with divider for growth) and an indoor playpen for supervised freedom. Crate should have solid build, good ventilation, and a comfortable washable mat. Playpen allows safe indoor exercise and separation in the apartment.
needs.rationale: Crate training is essential for housetraining and safe confinement in apartments, and a playpen offers an indoor safe area during noisy yard maintenance or when leaving home. AJ is a young puppy in training and requires safe spaces.

needs.description: Deshedding brush designed for short-coated breeds (e.g., FURminator-style de-shedding tool), grooming glove, quality slicker brush, and lint rollers. Tools should be easy to clean and sized for a compact body. Include grooming wipes for quick fur removal and allergy-season management.
needs.rationale: Calendar shows Fall Shedding Season and allergy season is active. Pugs shed heavily and will need de-shedding tools to minimize loose hair indoors (important for apartment living and owner comfort/allergy control).
evidence: standard: increased grooming during shedding season

needs.description: HEPA air purifier sized for apartment living room/bedroom to reduce airborne allergens plus hypoallergenic, washable dog bedding and covers that trap dander. Use machine-washable materials and breathable designs to reduce heat retention.
needs.rationale: Fall allergy season is active and AJ (and household) will benefit from reduced airborne allergens. Washable bedding reduces dander accumulation from a heavy-shedding breed.
evidence: standard: air quality control during allergy season

needs.description: Quality guillotine or scissor-style nail trimmers and a file, non-irritating paw balm to protect pads from hot pavement and seasonal rough surfaces, and scented- or hypoallergenic paw wipes to clean irritants after yard play.
needs.rationale: Routine nail maintenance and paw care protect joints and comfort. During heat events, paws can heat on pavement and require protection and balm. AJ's high activity level and yard access increase paw wear.
evidence: standard: routine nail and paw care

needs.description: Clicker and target stick for positive reinforcement training, potty bells or indoor potty pads for apartment transitions, treat pouch for on-the-go training. Materials should be durable and easy to clean.
needs.rationale: AJ is a 7-month puppy in a household that may need adjusted routines (school year schedule). Training aids accelerate obedience, housetraining, and recall—crucial for safety during hunting season and in a busy apartment building.

needs.family: Waste Management (Poop Bags, Enzymatic Cleaners, Odor Control)
needs.description: Biodegradable poop bags (bulk), sealed odor-proof waste bin for the apartment, enzyme-based stain and odor cleaner for accidents, and carpet cleaner attachments. Choose sturdy bags for larger stools and strong dogs.
needs.rationale: Apartment living requires reliable waste handling and odor control. Enzyme cleaners are necessary for effective removal of puppy accidents during housetraining and to reduce attraction to resoiling.
evidence: standard: odor control and enzymatic cleaners for housetraining

needs.description: Durable engraved ID tag with up-to-date contact info, and harness attachment for ID. Consider quick-release or breakaway designs for certain collars used around the house. Keep tags waterproof and securely attached to harness.
needs.rationale: Essential safety item for any dog; critical when out in public, during hunting season, and for a strong puppy that may bolt. IDs are inexpensive, immediate protective items.
evidence: about: AJ is very energetic and very strong

needs.description: Crash-tested car harness or seatbelt-compatible restraint sized for a growing medium-to-large puppy; durable buckles and padding for comfort. Also include a travel blanket or seat cover to protect vehicle upholstery from hair and mud.
needs.rationale: For safe travel in cars (road trips, vet trips), restraining AJ prevents injury during sudden stops and protects passengers. He is strong and energetic—secure travel gear is necessary.
evidence: about: AJ is very energetic and very strong
standard: use restraints for pets in vehicles

needs.description: Washable elevated mesh bed or orthopedic foam bed sized to the pug’s body for support; breathable materials to limit heat retention. Prefer machine-washable covers and non-toxic fillings.
needs.rationale: Improves comfort, joint support, and airflow (important during heat). Elevated beds reduce contact with hot floors and facilitate cooling compared with dense foam.
evidence: standard: provide comfortable restful areas for puppies

needs.description: Non-pharmaceutical calming solutions such as a snug anxiety wrap (Thundershirt-style), dog-appeasing pheromone diffuser for the apartment, and interactive calming toys. Avoid assuming anxiety but provide these during noisy events (leaf blowers, hunting season) as optional tools.
needs.rationale: Calendar includes leaf blower and hunting seasons that can cause noise anxiety. Even if AJ has no current anxiety, these non-medical aids are low-risk and helpful during loud events or storms.
evidence: standard: non-medical calming tools for stress-inducing events

needs.description: Mild, fragrance-free hypoallergenic dog shampoo and waterless wipes for quick cleaning after yard play. Choose products formulated for sensitive skin and safe for puppies; avoid ingredients associated with common sensitivities.
needs.rationale: During allergy season and shedding, topical cleaning helps remove pollen and allergens from AJ’s coat after outdoor time. Wipes are convenient for quick cleanups to limit indoor allergen spread.
evidence: standard: topical cleaning for allergy/allergen control

needs.description: Over-the-counter puppy supplements focused on joint support (glucosamine appropriate for puppies), omega fatty acids for skin/coat, and probiotics for digestive support. Choose chewable or powder forms appropriate for a puppy and compatible with feeding plan; avoid products containing duck.
needs.rationale: Given AJ’s high weight and activity level, joint-supporting nutrients and digestive support can help during growth. These are non-prescription supportive items to complement nutrition (discuss with vet for dosing).
evidence: standard: supportive supplements for growing, active dogs

needs.description: Handheld or apartment-sized vacuum with pet/hair attachments and rubber brush tools to remove pug hair from furniture and floors; include lint rollers and fabric brushes for quick touch-ups.
needs.rationale: Pugs shed a lot and AJ is in shedding season; keeping a pet-focused vacuum reduces hair accumulation in an apartment and helps allergy control.
evidence: standard: manage shedding with targeted tools
